steps.name: Sample structure QC
steps.context: Raw integer gene-level Salmon counts, 12000 genes x 12 samples, single batch, no known covariates beyond condition.
steps.question: Do the 12 samples cluster by condition (control, treated_a, treated_b) in unsupervised PCA/sample-distance space, and is any sample a library-size or clustering outlier?

grounding.reason: 3-group, 4-replicate, single-batch counts: run blind-vst/PCA/sample-distance QC per R-0033 before any model.

steps.description: Blind VST, PCA on top-500-variance genes, sample-distance heatmap, and library-size bar plot across the 12 liver samples (control n=4, treated_a n=4, treated_b n=4) to confirm the three groups separate before any test runs and flag any outlier sample.
acceptance_criteria: PCA plot and sample-distance heatmap produced, colored by condition
Library size per sample reported
Any sample failing to cluster with its group or with markedly low library size is flagged explicitly, not silently dropped

steps.name: DESeq2 LRT any-difference test + pairwise Wald contrasts vs control
steps.context: Raw Salmon gene-level counts (12000 x 13 CSV incl. gene symbol column), 3 groups x 4 replicates, unpaired, single batch, no known covariates. Reference level for condition must be set explicitly to 'control' since alphabetical order is not guaranteed to match.
steps.question: Which genes differ across control, treated_a, and treated_b at all (LRT), and which genes does treated_a and treated_b each change relative to control (pairwise Wald contrasts)?

grounding.reason: 3 groups x 4 reps, no batch: DESeq2 LRT (full ~condition vs reduced ~1) for any-difference, then pairwise Wald contrasts vs the explicit reference level 'control', ashr shrinkage, BH-FDR within each test per R-0059/R-0060/R-0040/R-0061.

steps.description: Load counts.csv (12000 genes x 12 samples) and metadata.csv, build a DESeqDataSet with condition releveled so 'control' is the reference. Pre-filter to genes with >=10 counts in >=4 samples (smallest group size). Fit the full model ~condition and test against the reduced model ~1 with the DESeq2 likelihood ratio test to find every gene that differs among control, treated_a, and treated_b at all. Separately, extract two named pairwise Wald contrasts from the same fit: condition treated_a vs control, and condition treated_b vs control. Shrink each contrast's log2FoldChange with ashr (contrasts of two non-reference levels are not single coefficients, so apeglm does not apply here; apeglm can be used for the single-coefficient treated_a-vs-control and treated_b-vs-control coefficients if convenient, but ashr is used uniformly for consistency). Report BH-adjusted p-values within each test (LRT and each Wald contrast) separately with independent filtering on, alpha=0.05. Flag genes with NA padj from Cook's-distance outlier detection (n=4 per group, below the 7-replicate auto-replace threshold) separately from genes removed by independent filtering.
acceptance_criteria: Genes pre-filtered to >=10 counts in >=4 samples before DESeq()
DESeq2 LRT (full=~condition, reduced=~1) run and its results table (padj, stat) reported as the any-group-difference gene list
Two named Wald contrasts extracted: c('condition','treated_a','control') and c('condition','treated_b','control')
ashr-shrunken log2FoldChange reported alongside unshrunken log2FoldChange and lfcSE for each contrast
BH-adjusted p-values (alpha=0.05) with independent filtering reported per test, each gene table labeled with its contrast/test name
MA plot and dispersion plot produced as fit diagnostics
Count of NA-padj genes from Cook's outlier flagging reported separately from independent-filtering NAs

steps.name: fgsea preranked GSEA per contrast (Hallmark, then Reactome)
steps.context: Human liver bulk RNA-seq, 3-way comparison. Hallmark gene sets (50 sets, HGNC symbols) and Reactome pathway gene sets (current release, multi-species GMT filtered to human via ReactomePathways.txt) are staged in the reference store.
steps.question: Which Hallmark and Reactome pathways are enriched among genes that differ across all three groups (LRT), and which are enriched specifically in treated_a vs control and treated_b vs control?

grounding.reason: Human enrichment, ranked-list input, 3 groups: fgsea preranked on the test statistic against Hallmark first then Reactome, per contrast, per rule R-0048/R-0104; knowledge_check confirmed this combination is permitted (ok:true).

steps.description: For the LRT any-difference gene list and for each pairwise Wald contrast (treated_a vs control, treated_b vs control) separately, rank all tested genes by their DESeq2 test statistic (LRT stat for the LRT list; Wald stat for each pairwise contrast) and run fgsea preranked GSEA against the MSigDB Hallmark human gene sets (50 sets, 2026.1 release) as the first pass. Follow up significant hallmark hits with a second enrichment pass against the Reactome human pathway gene sets (current release, filtered to Homo sapiens via the pathway index). Gene sets restricted to 15-500 members after intersecting with the tested-gene universe. Do not pool ranked lists across contrasts. Map gene symbols to Entrez where needed via org.Hs.eg.db, report the unmapped share.
acceptance_criteria: Three separate ranked lists used as input: LRT stat, treated_a-vs-control Wald stat, treated_b-vs-control Wald stat — never pooled
fgsea run against Hallmark (min_size=15, max_size=500) for each of the three ranked lists, BH-adjusted
Reactome run as the second-pass collection on the same three ranked lists, filtered to Homo sapiens gene sets only
Leading-edge genes reported for every significant gene set
Gene-set collection versions (Hallmark 2026.1, Reactome current release date) stated in output
Share of unmapped/multiply-mapped gene symbols reported if Entrez mapping is used

steps.name: Assemble DE + enrichment report
steps.context: Combines outputs of the DESeq2 LRT+Wald step and the fgsea enrichment step for the 3-group, 4-replicate-each liver design.
steps.question: What is the final, reproducible summary of genes differing across the three liver groups and genes changed by each treatment relative to control, with pathway context?

grounding.reason: No single differential_expression/enrichment rule covers the report step directly; report-content rules (R-0041, R-0085, R-0087, R-0051, R-0086 etc.) were folded in as constraints.

steps.description: Assemble a single report combining: the QC plots, the DESeq2 fit diagnostics (MA plot, dispersion plot), the three gene result tables (LRT any-difference; treated_a vs control; treated_b vs control) with unshrunken log2FoldChange, ashr-shrunken log2FoldChange, lfcSE, and BH-padj per gene, each table labeled with its contrast/test name, ranked for display by the shrunken log2FoldChange; the p-value histograms for each test before BH adjustment; the fgsea Hallmark and Reactome tables per contrast with leading-edge genes; and a full reproducibility record (R/Bioconductor session info, DESeq2/ashr/fgsea versions, gene-set collection versions and release dates, any random seed used).
acceptance_criteria: Report states design formula, reference level (control), and each named contrast
Report states pre-filter threshold, alpha=0.05, independent filtering on, and n_tested vs n_DE per contrast
MA plot and dispersion plot included
Gene tables include shrunken and unshrunken log2FoldChange plus lfcSE, ranked by shrunken value
Enrichment tables state gene-set database, version, ranking metric (test statistic), universe, and size window (15-500), with leading-edge genes
Session info, package versions, and gene-set collection versions recorded

plan.title: Liver 3-group DESeq2 LRT + pairwise DE vs control
plan.analytical_narrative: 12 liver samples in 3 groups (control, treated_a, treated_b; n=4 each), raw Salmon gene counts, single batch, unpaired. Two questions are asked: (1) which genes differ across all three groups at all — answered by the DESeq2 likelihood ratio test, full model ~condition vs reduced ~1; (2) which genes each treatment changes relative to control — answered by two pairwise Wald contrasts (treated_a vs control, treated_b vs control) with condition releveled so control is the reference. QC (blind VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap) runs first to confirm the 3 groups separate and no sample is an outlier before any test. Low-count pre-filtering keeps genes with >=10 counts in >=4 samples (the smallest group size); DESeq2's own independent filtering does the rest at the results stage. LFCs are shrunk with ashr (contrasts, not single coefficients, so apeglm does not apply) and reported alongside the unshrunken estimate. BH-FDR at alpha=0.05 is applied within each contrast/test separately, with contrast identity carried on every reported gene. Each contrast (and the LRT any-difference gene list) is then run through fgsea preranked GSEA on the DESeq2 Wald/LRT statistic against MSigDB Hallmark (2026.1, human, 50 sets) as the first pass and Reactome (current release) as the second collection — separately per contrast, never pooled. A final report step assembles fit diagnostics (MA plot, dispersion plot), the gene tables (shrunken/unshrunken LFC, padj, contrast label), the enrichment tables with leading-edge genes, and a full reproducibility record (session info, seed, package and gene-set-collection versions).
